test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper kept the marked price of an item at Rs. 500. He sold it at a scheme discount of 10% and 20% and got a profit of 25%. What was the cost price of the item?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹500

Discounts = 10% and 20%

Profit = 25%

**Formula used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 - Discount1) × (1 - Discount2)

Cost Price (CP) = SP / (1 + Profit)

**Calculation:**

SP = 500 × (1 - 0.10) × (1 - 0.20)

⇒ SP = 500 × 0.90 × 0.80

⇒ SP = 500 × 0.72

⇒ SP = ₹360

CP = 360 / (1 + 0.25)

⇒ CP = 360 / 1.25

⇒ CP = ₹288

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**
